rounds.response: Hi — I’m Sam from residential support, sorry your internet has been down overnight and I know that’s stressful with work tomorrow. To get started I can run remote diagnostics and attempt a remote reboot — please send your service address (or account number) and the best phone number on the account so I can look up your service. While you send that, can you tell me whether the modem/router power and Internet/WAN lights are on, and whether no devices connect at all or some can connect to Wi‑Fi but have no internet? Once I pull the diagnostics I’ll either restore service now, schedule a technician for the earliest available morning window, and note the urgency on your account; we can also apply a short service credit if the outage spans tonight.
